author: Mark Atwood
text: Blocked on JMAP-826m.14. The natural fix here — replace state_for_test()'s MutexGuard exposure with explicit fixture-injection methods (record_created_id, record_destroyed_id, set_state) — is meaningless if .14 resolves toward 'drop MockBackend entirely; move all tests to tests/ using MemoryBackend'. Recommend addressing together with .14 once the canonical-template decision is made.
